title: MATH GAOKAO - 139
description: Authentic-style mathematics problems inspired by China’s Gaokao — build deeper understanding, sharper thinking, and real exam readiness.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate the sine of \(30^\circ\) using exact trigonometric values.
questions.question:
Evaluate
\[
\sin 30^\circ.
\]
questions.explanation:
From the standard trigonometric values,
\[
\sin 30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}.
\]
Therefore, the correct value is \(\frac{1}{2}\).
questions.hint: Recall the exact value of sine at \(30^\circ\).

\cos 45^\circ.
\]
questions.explanation:
From the standard trigonometric values,
\[
\cos 45^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}.
\]

questions.hint: Recall the exact value of cosine at \(45^\circ\).
